source.note: Hand-authored. Mechanics the BattleScribe-derived data does not express, each with the page it comes from. Loaded and checked against units.json by @tc/rules (unit-rules.ts); edit by hand, not by the converter.

replaceableBuiltIns.name: Catherine Wheel
replaceableBuiltIns.text: An Anchorite Shrine has a Bonebreaker Mace and a Catherine Wheel. These Weapons are built into the Anchorite Shrine and cannot be removed or lost.

replacements.text: When you recruit an Anchorite Shrine, you can replace its Catherine Wheel with one of the Anchorite Ranged Weapons. They are counted as 1-Handed weapons when used by an Anchorite Shrine.

permanentItems.text: Once equipped, the Battlekit cannot be removed or lost from the Anchorite Shrine for any reason.

statOverrides.text: Anchorite Shrines in a War Pilgrimage of Saint Methodius Warband have a Ranged Characteristic of +0 DICE instead of -.
The Bereaved: The Grail Thralls or Fly Thralls in a Dirge of the Great Hegemon Warband are called the Bereaved. They have a Ranged Characteristic of +0 DICE and a cost of 30 ducats.

A Wretched Chorus: Wretched models in a Drowned Choir cost 30 ducats and have a Melee Characteristic of +0 DICE. Wretched models within 8" of any number of Drowned Chorister or Leviathal Chorus models have a Melee Characteristic of +1 DICE instead of +0 DICE.
Melee-focused: Mechanized Heavy Infantry in a Kingdom of Alba Assault Detachment Warband have a Melee Characteristic of +1 DICE and a Ranged Characteristic of +0 DICE.

preGameChoices.name: Broken on the Wheel

unavailable.text: Mortal Sin: models in a War Pilgrimage of Saint Methodius cannot be Broken on the Wheel

preGameChoices.summary: Arm 0, no NEGATE SHRAPNEL or TOUGH, Down counts as a Minor Hit, until its first Out of Action
preGameChoices.effect: Until the Anchorite Shrine first suffers an Out of Action result: it has an Armour Characteristic of 0 and does not have the NEGATE SHRAPNEL and TOUGH Keywords, and it treats Down results as Minor Hit results. The first Out of Action result is treated as No Effect; its BLOOD MARKERS are removed and these rules end: Armour -3, NEGATE SHRAPNEL and TOUGH return (TOUGH applies from the next Out of Action). The victim is permanently removed from the warband.

variantPrices.text: Claymore Smiths: Great Swords/Axes cost 7 ducats instead of 12 for models from a Kingdom of Alba Assault Detachment Warband.
The Machine Gun and Submachine Gun entries in the War Pilgrimage of Saint Methodius Armoury replace those in the standard Trench Pilgrim Armoury. Machine Gun | Limit: 2 | 50 ducats.

The Machine Gun and Submachine Gun entries in the War Pilgrimage of Saint Methodius Armoury replace those in the standard Trench Pilgrim Armoury. Submachine Gun | Bayonet Lug, Shield Combo, Limit: 1 | 30 ducats.
Stolen Communicants: Communicants cost 3 glory to recruit for a Cavalcade of the Tenth Plague Warband (they do not cost any ducats).

Goetic Warlocks: A Knights of Avarice Warband can include up to 2 Goetic Warlocks as Mercenaries. In addition, the first Goetic Warlock to be recruited in a Knights of Avarice Warband costs 110 ducats instead of its normal cost in glory.
The Bereaved: The Grail Thralls or Fly Thralls in a Dirge of the Great Hegemon Warband are called the Bereaved. They have a Ranged Characteristic of +0 DICE and a cost of 30 ducats.
A Wretched Chorus: Wretched models in a Drowned Choir cost 30 ducats and have a Melee Characteristic of +0 DICE.

variantSubstituteUnits.name: Sipahi Automaton Cavalry
variantSubstituteUnits.text: Sipahi: A Defenders of the Iron Wall Warband can include up to 1 Sipahi Automaton Cavalry at a cost of 110 ducats. They use the Mercenary Entry for a Mamluk Faris but you cannot change their Battlekit in any way. Note that this does not stop you from recruiting a Mamluk Faris as a Mercenary as well.

variantSubstituteUnits.name: Fāris
variantSubstituteUnits.text: Noble Guardians: A House of Wisdom can include 0-2 Fāris. The Fāris use the Janissary Warband Entry, but have the ELITE Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.

freeKeywordGrants.name: Swiss Guard
freeKeywordGrants.text: Swiss Guard: The Lieutenant and up to 4 models in a Papal States Intervention Force Warband can have the NEGATE FEAR Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.

freeKeywordGrants.name: Janissary Officers
freeKeywordGrants.text: Janissary Officers: A Defenders of the Iron Wall Warband can have 0-2 Janissaries, which have the ELITE Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.

freeKeywordGrants.name: Killing Squad
freeKeywordGrants.text: Killing Squad: A Fida'i of Alamut Warband can include 1 Fireteam, consisting of any 2 models from the Warband. Both of the models in the Fireteam are given the FIRETEAM Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.

freeKeywordGrants.name: Only the Strong Survive
freeKeywordGrants.text: Only the Strong Survive: Leviathan Shoal Warbands can include 0-4 Anointed Heretic Raiders, and up to 1 can be recruited with the ELITE Keyword at no extra cost.

freeAtCreation.name: Supreme Blessing
freeAtCreation.text: Supreme Blessing: When you recruit a Papal States Intervention Force Warband, you must give the Supreme Pontiff's Crucifix to one model in the Warband. The Supreme Pontiff's Crucifix taken when the Warband is created is free and does not cost any glory (if it is lost then the replacement must be paid for normally).

purseAdjustments.name: Specialist Force
purseAdjustments.text: Specialist Force: A Papal States Intervention Force gains 4 glory each time it calls for Reinforcements.

variantRenames.name: Silahdar
variantRenames.text: Silahdar: The commanders of the Iron Wall's units come from the personal bodyguards of the Sultan known as Silahdar. A Defenders of the Iron Wall Warband must include 1 Silahdar. The Silahdar uses the Yüzbaşı Warband Entry, except that it replaces the Mubarizun ability with the STRONG Keyword.

variantRenames.name: Dervish
variantRenames.text: Dervishes: A Fida'i of Alamut Warband can include 0-4 Dervishes. The Dervishes use the Janissaries Warband Entry, but cannot wear Reinforced Armour and replace the STRONG Keyword with the IGNORE OFF-HAND WEAPON Keyword and the Whirling Dervish ability.

variantRenames.name: Bereaved
variantRenames.text: The Bereaved: The Grail Thralls or Fly Thralls in a Dirge of the Great Hegemon Warband are called the Bereaved.

variantRenames.name: Holy Warrior
variantRenames.text: Holy Warriors: An Expeditionary Forces of Abyssinia Warband can include 0-1 Trench Cleric and 0-2 Holy Warriors. Use the Trench Clerics Warband Entry for Holy Warriors.

variantRenames.name: Master Assassin
variantRenames.text: Master Assassin: A Fida'i of Alamut Warband must include 1 Master Assassin. The Master Assassin uses the Sultanate Assassin Warband Entry, except that it has the LEADER and TOUGH Keywords and has a cost of 95 ducats.

variantRenames.name: Barbed Wire Banshee
variantRenames.text: Barbed Wire Banshee: A Trench Ghost Warband can include a Barbed Wire Banshee instead of a Chorister. The Barbed Wire Banshee has the same Profile and Cost as a Chorister.

variantRenames.name: Executor
variantRenames.text: The Executor: A Dirge of the Great Hegemon Warband must include 1 Executor. The Executor uses the Plague Knight Warband Entry, except that it has a Ranged Characteristic of +1 DICE and the LEADER and TOUGH Keywords, and has a cost of 80 ducats.

variantRenames.name: Leviathal Chorus
variantRenames.text: A Song Within the Deep: 1 Drowned Chorister must take the Leviathal Chorus upgrade at a cost of 20 ducats. The Drowned Chorister with the Leviathal Chorus upgrade increases its base size to 40mm, has the LEADER and TOUGH Keywords.

variantKeywords.text: Lector: A Papal States Intervention Force Warband must include 1 Trench Cleric, but does not have to include a Lieutenant. A Trench Cleric in a Papal States Intervention Force Warband has the LEADER Keyword.
Loose Formation: The Lieutenant in an Éire Rangers Warband replaces their Hold Your Fire! ability with the SKIRMISHER Keyword at no change to their cost in ducats.
Highland Strength: The Lieutenant and any Shock Troopers in a Kingdom of Alba Assault Detachment Warband have the STRONG Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.
Rampant Charge: Models in a Kingdom of Alba Assault Detachment Warband have the IGNORE DEFENDED OBSTACLE Keyword.
Blood of the Lamb: Castigators in a Cavalcade of the Tenth Plague Warband have the TOUGH Keyword at no additional cost in ducats.
Dervishes: The Dervishes use the Janissaries Warband Entry, but cannot wear Reinforced Armour and replace the STRONG Keyword with the IGNORE OFF-HAND WEAPON Keyword and the Whirling Dervish ability.
Silahdar: The Silahdar uses the Yüzbaşı Warband Entry, except that it replaces the Mubarizun ability with the STRONG Keyword.
Undead Horror: Models in this Warband have the FEAR, NEGATE DIFFICULT TERRAIN, and NEGATE GAS Keywords.
Only the Strong Survive: In addition, Heretic Captains in this Warband have the STRONG Keyword.
The Executor uses the Plague Knight Warband Entry, except that it has a Ranged Characteristic of +1 DICE and the LEADER and TOUGH Keywords.
The Master Assassin uses the Sultanate Assassin Warband Entry, except that it has the LEADER and TOUGH Keywords and has a cost of 95 ducats.
Berserker: In addition, a Berserker has the NEGATE FEAR Keyword, and BLOOD MARKERS are never placed on them under any circumstances.
Fianna: Shock Troopers in an Éire Rangers Warband can have the INFILTRATOR and SKIRMISHER Keywords for +10 ducats per model.
Forward Positions: Up to 2 Shock Troopers in a Stosstruppen of the Free State of Prussia Warband can have the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 ducats each.
Assassin Acolytes: Up to three Azeb models in a Fida'i of Alamut Warband can be given the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 ducats each.
Unseen Advance: Up to 3 models without the ELITE Keyword in a Heretic Naval Raiders Warband can be given the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 ducats each.
Wrath of God: BLOOD MARKERS are never placed next to a model with the Wrath of God special rule, and it has the NEGATE FEAR Keyword.
Wings (30 ducats): Change this Takwin Homunculus's Movement Characteristic to 8"/Flying and give it the FLYING Keyword.
Regenerative Tissue (25 ducats): This Takwin Homunculus gains the REGENERATE 1 Keyword.
Elemental Resistance (40 ducats): Give this Takwin Homunculus the NEGATE FIRE and NEGATE GAS Keywords.
Philosophy, Poetry and Theology (20 ducats): The Alchemist has the NEGATE FEAR Keyword.
Keywords: BLACK GRAIL, FEAR, FLYING (Fly Thralls only), NEGATE GAS.

firstPurchaseDiscounts.name: Cold Steel
firstPurchaseDiscounts.text: Cold Steel: Halve the cost of a Melee Weapon the first time that is purchased for a Kingdom of Alba Assault Detachment Warband. For example, the first Sword/Axe purchased for a Warband would cost 2 ducats while any further Swords/Axes would cost 4 ducats each.

crossFactionArmoury.name: Corrupt Merchants
crossFactionArmoury.text: Corrupt Merchants: When you create your starting Warband, you can purchase 1 piece of Battlekit from the New Antioch Armoury, and 1 piece of Battlekit from the Iron Sultanate Armoury. Any stipulations that apply to it must still be followed. You can repurchase the Battlekit later during the campaign if it is lost for any reason.

crossFactionArmoury.name: Corrupt Merchants
crossFactionArmoury.text: Corrupt Merchants: When you create your starting Warband, you can purchase 1 piece of Battlekit from the New Antioch Armoury, and 1 piece of Battlekit from the Iron Sultanate Armoury. Any stipulations that apply to it must still be followed. You can repurchase the Battlekit later during the campaign if it is lost for any reason.

crossFactionArmoury.name: Weapon Collections
crossFactionArmoury.text: Weapon Collections: When you create your starting Warband, you can purchase 1 piece of Battlekit from the New Antioch Armoury, and 1 piece of Battlekit from the Trench Pilgrims Armoury. Any stipulations that apply to it are followed. You can repurchase the Battlekit later during the campaign if it is lost for any reason.

crossFactionArmoury.name: Weapon Collections
crossFactionArmoury.text: Weapon Collections: When you create your starting Warband, you can purchase 1 piece of Battlekit from the New Antioch Armoury, and 1 piece of Battlekit from the Trench Pilgrims Armoury. Any stipulations that apply to it are followed. You can repurchase the Battlekit later during the campaign if it is lost for any reason.

warbandHeldItems.name: Grand Cannon gun battery
warbandHeldItems.text: Grand Cannons: A Defenders of the Iron Wall Warband can include 0-2 Sultanate Grand Cannons at a cost of 60 ducats each. When a Grand Cannon is added to a Defender of the Iron Wall Warband it must either be given to a Brazen Bull that is already part of the Warband, or added to the Armoury on the Warband's roster sheet as a Grand Cannon gun battery. No more than 1 Grand Cannon can be given to a Brazen Bull model, and a Warband cannot have more than 2 Grand Cannons in total.

currencyChoices.text: Grail Devotee | 15 ducats or 2 glory | ELITE only, Limit: 2. Jealous Obsession: The Limit of 2 is the number of models that can have Grail Devotees; each model can have up to 2 Grail Devotees. The cost of the second Grail Devotee taken for a model is paid in glory instead of ducats.

minimumModelCosts.name: Mammon's Chosen
minimumModelCosts.text: Mammon's Chosen: A Knights of Avarice Warband cannot include a model if the cost of the model and its Battlekit is less than 80 ducats, unless the model is a Wretched.

upgradeRequirements.name: Heretic Legionnaires
upgradeRequirements.text: Heretic Legionnaires: You can upgrade Heretic Troopers in your Warband to Heretic Legionnaires, at a cost of +10 ducats each. When you upgrade a Heretic Trooper to a Heretic Legionnaire, you can change either their Ranged Characteristic or their Melee Characteristic from 0 to +1.

upgradeRequirements.name: Heretic Raider Legionnaires
upgradeRequirements.text: Heretic Raider Legionnaires: You can upgrade Heretic Raiders in your Warband to Heretic Raider Legionnaires, at a cost of 10 ducats each. When you upgrade a Heretic Raider to a Heretic Raider Legionnaire, you can change either their Ranged Characteristic or their Melee Characteristic from 0 to +1.

upgradeRequirements.name: Plague Knight Ranks
upgradeRequirements.text: Plague Knight Ranks: Each Plague Knight in a Warband can be given one of the following Plague Knight Ranks at the indicated cost in ducats.

upgradeRequirements.name: Knight Companion of the Fly
upgradeRequirements.text: Knight Companion of the Fly (5 ducats): Add +1 DICE to either the Ranged or the Melee Characteristic of this Plague Knight (you can choose which of the Characteristics to increase).

upgradeRequirements.name: Knight of the Rotten Cross
upgradeRequirements.text: Knight of the Rotten Cross (5 ducats, Limit: 1): You can purchase 1 Ranged Weapon or 1 Melee Weapon from the New Antioch or Heretic Legions Armoury Tables for this model.

upgradeRequirements.name: Gargantuan Size
upgradeRequirements.text: Gargantuan Size (20 ducats): A Takwin Homunculus can only have this Alchemical Formula if it already has the Human Hands, Inhuman Strength, and Massive Size Alchemical Formulas.

upgradeRequirements.name: Hawk Eyes
upgradeRequirements.text: Hawk Eyes (10 ducats): A Homunculus cannot have the Hawk Eyes Alchemical Formula if it has the Hypnotic Eyes Alchemical Formula unless it also has the Two Heads Alchemical Formula.

upgradeRequirements.name: Hypnotic Eyes
upgradeRequirements.text: Hypnotic Eyes (15 ducats): A Homunculus cannot have the Hypnotic Eyes Alchemical Formula if it has the Hawk Eyes Alchemical Formula unless it also has the Two Heads Alchemical Formula.

upgradeRequirements.name: Berserker
upgradeRequirements.text: Berserker: The Lieutenant or one of the Fianna in an Éire Rangers Warband can be upgraded to a Berserker for +15 ducats.

upgradeRequirements.name: Kavasses
upgradeRequirements.text: Kavasses: You can change the Melee Characteristic of up to 3 Azebs in a House of Wisdom Warband from -1 DICE to +0 DICE at a cost of +5 ducats each. However, these Azebs lose the Light Skirmisher ability.

upgradeRequirements.name: Kavasses
upgradeRequirements.text: Kavasses: However, these Azebs lose the Light Skirmisher ability.

upgradeRequirements.name: Medicine
upgradeRequirements.text: Medicine (15 ducats): This Alchemist is a student of Ibn Sina's School of Medicine. This Alchemist cannot have a Medi-kit.

upgradeRequirements.name: Unseen Advance
upgradeRequirements.text: Unseen Advance: Up to 3 models without the ELITE Keyword in a Heretic Naval Raiders Warband can be given the INFILTRATOR Keyword at a cost of +10 ducats each.
